abstract: Gastric teratoma is a very rare tumour that usually manifests as an abdominal mass, resulting in gastrointestinal bleeding and/or obstructive features. We report gastric teratoma occurring in a two-year-old boy who presented with an abdominal mass. Diagnosis was aided by the classical findings of teratoma on computed tomography, seen as the presence of fat, calcifications, and both solid and cystic areas.
abstract_ja: 胃奇形腫はきわめてまれな腫瘍で、通常は腹部腫瘤として発症し、消化管出血や閉塞症状をきたす。われわれは腹部腫瘤を主訴とした2歳男児の胃奇形腫の症例を報告する。診断は、コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)における奇形腫に特徴的な所見、すなわち脂肪、石灰化、ならびに充実性と嚢胞性の領域の存在によって補助された。
